scenario: [LGRA.9.6.2]: `bit_count` is a zero-argument member of `Int` and is written without an argument list. `r.flags.bit_count()` writes one, so the compiler refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER. The member exists, so a check that only looked the name up would pass this rule.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    k: Int key
    flags: Int mutable

rule check:
    R r where r.flags.bit_count() > 1
->
    log info "x"
